name: quote-tweets
description: Quote tweets over someone else's post (usually David Senra / Founders Podcast). Your text sits above the quoted tweet. It's SHORT — 1-3 sentences max. Either: (1) a killer quote from the source with attribution, (2) a bold one-line take or framing that adds context, (3) a personal connection ('This made me think of...') plus a related quote. The quote tweet text should make someone want to click into the quoted post. No lengthy analysis.
examples:
Peter Thiel on Demis:

“I always say that people aren't really entrepreneurs in the abstract, but there's maybe one great company that somebody has in them. It was Demis's destiny to build this one.”
You don't grind to a $20 billion net worth without complete product quality obsession. This is the perfect example of what true product obsession sounds like:
One of my favorite parts from Todd Graves's story is where his CFO suggested using slightly lower quality ingredients so they could make more money and Todd fired him

"Failure is not an option. There's no option. It's success or death."

~ Michael Ovitz

This made me think of a great line I once read in a biography of Frank Lloyd Wright:

“There are only two or three human stories, and they go on repeating themselves as fiercely as if they had never happened before.”
